methods_quotes.q: Survey-based vaccination coverage is calculated as the proportion of persons in a target age group who received a vaccine dose.
DTP1-to-DTP3 dropout, an indicator of immunization program utilization, is calculated as the percentage of children who received DTP1 but not DTP3.
